description:
Upgrade your bathroom cabinetry with solid brass cabinet hardware designed to add a distinctive finishing touch in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. This 3-inch cabinet pull brings a balanced transitional look that pairs contemporary lines with traditional elements, helping you coordinate drawers and cabinet doors with matching pieces across a cabinet hardware collection.

Highlights:
- Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Cabinet-mount installation with all mounting hardware included
- Designer finishes help coordinate with versatile bath accessories
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Type: Cabinet pull
- Material: Brass
- Style: Traditional
- Mounting type: Cabinet mount
- Dimensions: 3.9-inch L x 1.6-inch H x 0.9-inch W
- Projection: 1-inch
- Weight: 0.8 lb

- Assembly required: No
- Included: Cabinet pull and all installation hardware
